The diff contains only deletions from two barrel/re-export index files:
- `components/ui/common/index.ts` is deleted entirely (10 re-exports removed).
- `components/ui/placePageExploreNav/index.ts` drops one named re-export (`CategoryQuicklinks`).

No new `+` lines introduce sinks, entry points, validators, or data flow. Barrel re-exports carry no runtime data — they only affect module resolution. The worst-case impact of removing a re-export is a build/import error at call sites, which is a functional concern, not a security one. No sensitive-to-observability, allowlist, gate/action, sink-arg, or fail-open pattern is present.
